Elena — thanks, quick reply with an actionable MAP and dates below. I've attached a one-page MAP PDF that mirrors this email. High level milestones (we can compress if you need earlier):

- Day 0 (approval): sign MAP and approve account contacts (you)
- Day 1-2: Redwood creates the customer org and provisions two API keys (one test, one staging)
- Day 2-4: IP allowlist — you provide CIDR ranges; Redwood applies and confirms connectivity tests
- Day 3-7: VPC peering request initiated (we send peering config + peering request file); peering slam depends on your infra owner (typically 24–72h)
- Day 7: Smoke test: generate tokens, run sample traffic, confirm KV caching and latency targets

Deliverables we will attach/need: mutual_action_plan_v1.pdf (attached), vpc-peering-request.txt (we send), and a short network questionnaire. Please confirm your public IP ranges (or let us know if you want us to work with your peering contact directly).

We're reserving an engineer (Karthik) to kick off the peering. Marissa will track milestones and procurement. If you confirm the target start week 2028-03-27 we can prioritize the key creation this week.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
